absentReason: Contracts are typed by the RFP pricing types (Type 1 units, Type 2 rate, Type 3 fixed) plus a holder type (hospital, insurer, surgeon, organisation, billable party). The seven named categories (RVG Default Post-paid, Pre-paid, Hospital, Surgeon Solo, Surgeon Group, Insurance) are not offered as categories.
